rows.topic: Epithelial compartment kept
rows.proposal: Keep an Epithelial compartment defined by Pan_Cytokeratin, E_cadherin (compared on the membrane) and EpCAM (majority_epithelial), with Keratin_14 and TP63 as shared epithelial evidence; epithelial cells away from leukocytes (epithelial_away) become the known-negative reference of the leukocyte markers (CD8, CD4, CD20, CD79a, CD11c, CD56, CD66, MPO, CD31, Vimentin) and the check of SMA; T cells are a further reference for non-T markers (CD20, CD79a, CD11c, CD66, MPO). SOX2's role is left 'none' until reviewed.
rows.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); maintainer 2026-10-31: epithelium is present in spleen
rows.rationale: The source method's leukocyte-marker references are endocrine/exocrine cells, which spleen lacks; epithelium is the remaining population that cannot carry leukocyte markers. The plan's further references 'CD3e on CD20+ cells' and 'CD68/CD163 on lymphocytes' have no population in levels.populations yet (only t_cells exists), so only T cells are added.

rows.topic: CD8+CD31+ littoral cells are not CD8 T cells
rows.proposal: A CD8+ cell with CD31 and no CD3e is not a T cell: it is never named CD8 T cell. As written, the T lineage is named only with CD3e positive (named_by broad), so such a cell is tagged T_not_named and falls to the pan label (Hematopoietic CD45+/-); the proposal is to record it instead as a canary conflict or an endothelial-compartment cell.
rows.affects: CD8;label T cell;label CD8 T cell
rows.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels)
rows.rationale: Red-pulp sinusoidal lining (littoral) cells express CD8a and CD31 without CD3e; counting them as CD8 T cells would inflate red-pulp T cells.

rows.topic: CD21 is on FDCs and B cells
rows.proposal: CD21 is shared hematopoietic evidence carried by B cells (adds depth, never names a cell); the manifest's CD21_positive_B_cell leaf stays descriptive and needs CD20 or CD79a; no FDC is named from CD21 alone.
rows.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); spleen manifest add_rules CD21_positive_B_cell
rows.rationale: Follicular dendritic cells carry CD21 without being B cells; CD21 alone cannot name either.

rows.topic: Macrophage without Iba1
rows.proposal: Iba1 is not on PC67 (CD45 holds its barcode, maintainer 2026-10-31). Macrophages follow the 10-27 owner rule instead of the sheet's Iba1 row: CD68+ or CD163+ (the broad Myeloid markers), CD3e and epithelial markers negative through the canary, labelled by the CD68/CD163 | M2Gal3/CD4 profile; CD206 and M2Gal3 add depth. CD45 is the pan-leukocyte marker, as in the source method. B3TUBB is absent, so Neural and Schwann are unavailable.
rows.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); owner rule 2026-10-27
rows.rationale: The selected sheet's Macrophage row needs Iba1, which PC67 does not acquire.

rows.topic: Endothelial only from structure objects
rows.proposal: Endothelial labels are structure rows (Blood vessel named by CD31, Lymphatic by Podoplanin); with no working spleen vessel or lymphatic object (SmallVessel calls 29-78 % of tissue on PC67, being retrained), no cell is named endothelial and CD31, CD34, Caveolin and Podoplanin add shared evidence only. Revisit after the vessel objects exist.
rows.affects: CD31;CD34;Caveolin;Podoplanin;label Endothelium Blood Vessel;label Endothelium Lymphatic
rows.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); owner 2026-10-30 structure-only ruling
rows.rationale: The 10-30 ruling allows endothelial cell types only through structure objects.

rows.topic: Object-enrichment checks must be independent of the object's own markers
rows.proposal: When spleen objects (regions, vessels) arrive, each object check records which channels built its object; a check on the object's own input marker is reported as non-independent, never as a pass. No check_objects entries are written now.
rows.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels)
rows.rationale: Regions and vessels come from classifiers reading the same channels; enrichment of a marker in an object built from that marker proves nothing.

rows.topic: Immune checks need a spleen reference population (method change)
rows.proposal: levels.py's immune-core, immune2 and whole-cell positivity checks read leukocyte markers on hormone-positive endocrine cells (cell_sets/populations 'hormone'), and canary.py's epithelial null includes them. Spleen has none, so those rates are not evaluable and the immune core stops on every section. Proposal: the tissue hook supplies that check population (spleen: epithelial_away, P1) so the same checks run; this changes ported code and is not done.
rows.source: raised while writing this registry (2026-11-01)
rows.rationale: Without it the spleen registry cannot pass the level selection: the method would stop rather than type.

rows.topic: cDC naming
rows.proposal: CD11c is a Myeloid:cDC subtype marker and CD209 shared myeloid evidence, but the Macrophage profile rule names every Myeloid cell by its CD68/CD163 profile and a CD11c-only cell (no CD68/CD163) is not named Myeloid. Proposal: decide whether cDC is its own lineage or a profile label.
rows.source: spleen manifest (cDC, CD141_positive_cDC rows); raised while writing this registry
rows.rationale: The selected sheet has cDC under Myeloid; the method's profile rule has no subtype path for it.

rows.topic: FOXP3 as a state; Treg not a subtype
rows.proposal: FOXP3 is a state flag on T cells (Treg = CD4 T cell with FOXP3 positive) rather than a T subtype competing with CD4/CD8 under the 'higher marker' rule.
rows.source: spleen manifest (Treg row); raised while writing this registry
rows.rationale: The 'higher' subtype rule would let FOXP3 compete with CD4 although Tregs are CD4+.

rows.topic: Epithelial compartment kept
rows.proposal: Keep an Epithelial compartment defined by Pan_Cytokeratin, E_cadherin (compared on the membrane) and EpCAM (majority_epithelial), with Keratin_14 and TP63 as shared epithelial evidence; epithelial cells away from leukocytes (epithelial_away) become the known-negative reference of the leukocyte markers (CD8, CD4, CD20, CD79a, CD11c, CD56, CD66, MPO, CD31, Vimentin) and the check of SMA; T cells are a further reference for non-T markers (CD20, CD79a, CD11c, CD66, MPO). SOX2's role is left 'none' until reviewed.
rows.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); maintainer 2026-10-31: epithelium is present in spleen
rows.rationale: The source method's leukocyte-marker references are endocrine/exocrine cells, which spleen lacks; epithelium is the remaining population that cannot carry leukocyte markers. The plan's further references 'CD3e on CD20+ cells' and 'CD68/CD163 on lymphocytes' have no population in levels.populations yet (only t_cells exists), so only T cells are added.
rows.decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted. Epithelium is present: the Epithelial branch of the 6551 sheet is kept in the spleen adaptation (core/panels/data/tissues/spleen/manifest.yml, a candidate lineage root) and epithelial cells away from leukocytes stay the known-negative reference of the leukocyte markers.

rows.topic: CD8+CD31+ littoral cells are not CD8 T cells
rows.proposal: A CD8+ cell with CD31 and no CD3e is not a T cell: it is never named CD8 T cell. As written, the T lineage is named only with CD3e positive (named_by broad), so such a cell is tagged T_not_named and falls to the pan label (Hematopoietic CD45+/-); the proposal is to record it instead as a canary conflict or an endothelial-compartment cell.
rows.affects: CD8;label T cell;label CD8 T cell
rows.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels)
rows.rationale: Red-pulp sinusoidal lining (littoral) cells express CD8a and CD31 without CD3e; counting them as CD8 T cells would inflate red-pulp T cells.
rows.decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted as a new class: 'Endothelial Sinusoidal CD8+' (Endothelial_Sinusoidal_CD8+), a child of Endothelial with CD8 positive, in the spleen adaptation's add_rules. It inherits Endothelial's CD3e negative, so such a cell is never a CD8 T cell, and it waits with Endothelial (P5).

rows.topic: CD21 is on FDCs and B cells
rows.proposal: CD21 is shared hematopoietic evidence carried by B cells (adds depth, never names a cell); the manifest's CD21_positive_B_cell leaf stays descriptive and needs CD20 or CD79a; no FDC is named from CD21 alone.
rows.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); spleen manifest add_rules CD21_positive_B_cell
rows.rationale: Follicular dendritic cells carry CD21 without being B cells; CD21 alone cannot name either.
rows.decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: the spleen hierarchy names cells, and its CD21_positive_B_cell leaf (selected 2026-10-26) needs CD20 or CD79a: no FDC is named from CD21. CD21 stays shared evidence in this registry.

rows.topic: Macrophage without Iba1
rows.proposal: Iba1 is not on PC67 (CD45 holds its barcode, maintainer 2026-10-31). Macrophages follow the 10-27 owner rule instead of the sheet's Iba1 row: CD68+ or CD163+ (the broad Myeloid markers), CD3e and epithelial markers negative through the canary, labelled by the CD68/CD163 | M2Gal3/CD4 profile; CD206 and M2Gal3 add depth. CD45 is the pan-leukocyte marker, as in the source method. B3TUBB is absent, so Neural and Schwann are unavailable.
rows.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); owner rule 2026-10-27
rows.rationale: The selected sheet's Macrophage row needs Iba1, which PC67 does not acquire.
rows.decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted: for PC67 the absent Iba1 is left out of the sheet's Macrophage OR group (omit_absent_anypos), so Macrophage = CD68 or M2Gal3 or CD163, CD11c and MPO negative.

rows.topic: Endothelial only from structure objects
rows.proposal: Endothelial labels are structure rows (Blood vessel named by CD31, Lymphatic by Podoplanin); with no working spleen vessel or lymphatic object (SmallVessel calls 29-78 % of tissue on PC67, being retrained), no cell is named endothelial and CD31, CD34, Caveolin and Podoplanin add shared evidence only. Revisit after the vessel objects exist.
rows.affects: CD31;CD34;Caveolin;Podoplanin;label Endothelium Blood Vessel;label Endothelium Lymphatic
rows.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); owner 2026-10-30 structure-only ruling
rows.rationale: The 10-30 ruling allows endothelial cell types only through structure objects.
rows.decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted: Endothelial is structure-only for spleen (structure_only in the spleen adaptation); until a vessel object exists a match there is unavailable, never negative. CD31, CD34, Caveolin and Podoplanin add evidence only.

rows.topic: Object-enrichment checks must be independent of the object's own markers
rows.proposal: When spleen objects (regions, vessels) arrive, each object check records which channels built its object; a check on the object's own input marker is reported as non-independent, never as a pass. No check_objects entries are written now.
rows.source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels)
rows.rationale: Regions and vessels come from classifiers reading the same channels; enrichment of a marker in an object built from that marker proves nothing.
rows.decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: withdrawn as not needed: no spleen object-enrichment check exists, and the spleen hierarchy uses none.

rows.topic: Immune checks need a spleen reference population (method change)
rows.proposal: levels.py's immune-core, immune2 and whole-cell positivity checks read leukocyte markers on hormone-positive endocrine cells (cell_sets/populations 'hormone'), and canary.py's epithelial null includes them. Spleen has none, so those rates are not evaluable and the immune core stops on every section. Proposal: the tissue hook supplies that check population (spleen: epithelial_away, P1) so the same checks run; this changes ported code and is not done.
rows.source: raised while writing this registry (2026-11-01)
rows.rationale: Without it the spleen registry cannot pass the level selection: the method would stop rather than type.
rows.decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted, with stromal cells added: the tissue hook check_population supplies the immune checks' and the canary Epithelial null's known-negative cells; for spleen, cells positive for an Epithelial majority marker or a Mesenchymal defining marker (SMA), isolated from leukocytes as hormone cells are. No CD45 criterion (it would pass the CD45 check by construction) and no Vimentin (shared with lymphocytes). Superseded for the immune checks by P12 (B cells).

rows.topic: cDC naming
rows.proposal: CD11c is a Myeloid:cDC subtype marker and CD209 shared myeloid evidence, but the Macrophage profile rule names every Myeloid cell by its CD68/CD163 profile and a CD11c-only cell (no CD68/CD163) is not named Myeloid. Proposal: decide whether cDC is its own lineage or a profile label.
rows.source: spleen manifest (cDC, CD141_positive_cDC rows); raised while writing this registry
rows.rationale: The selected sheet has cDC under Myeloid; the method's profile rule has no subtype path for it.
rows.decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: not adopted: cells are named by the 6551 spleen hierarchy, not by the CODEX identity step, and the sheet already has cDC under Myeloid (CD11c and HLA-DR positive, CD68 and CD163 negative). 'This indicates that either a robust spleen-specific typing hasn't been created or you are not using it.'

rows.topic: FOXP3 as a state; Treg not a subtype
rows.proposal: FOXP3 is a state flag on T cells (Treg = CD4 T cell with FOXP3 positive) rather than a T subtype competing with CD4/CD8 under the 'higher marker' rule.
rows.source: spleen manifest (Treg row); raised while writing this registry
rows.rationale: The 'higher' subtype rule would let FOXP3 compete with CD4 although Tregs are CD4+.
rows.decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: rejected: FOXP3 stays as the sheet has it, Treg a T subtype (CD4 and FOXP3 positive, CD8 negative).

rows.topic: CD45 is a majority marker in spleen
rows.proposal: CD45's background-peak level (peak_fwhm, carried from pancreas) lies above every spleen cell, since about 90 % carry CD45; use the method's levels for markers most cells carry (edge or gate, the selection choosing). Its known-negative check on isolated reference cells is unreadable on 4 of 8 sections (no reference cell is 20 um from every CD45+ cell).
rows.source: level-selection trial on the 8 PC67 sections, 2026-11-01
rows.rationale: The densest CD45 peak is the positive population in lymphoid tissue.
rows.decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted: CD45 levels by edge or gate, and its reference check read on all reference cells, not only isolated ones (registry check_isolation 'none'). The reference-check part is superseded by P12: CD45 is read as a positive rate among B cells. Superseded by R1: the registry was restarted from spleen measurements.

rows.topic: CD163 level in spleen
rows.proposal: CD163's background-peak levels give 0 % positive on every section (one dominant mode, no right tail; HDL034 and HDL059 differ in shape).
rows.source: level-selection trial on the 8 PC67 sections, 2026-11-01
rows.rationale: The dominant mode is read as background.
rows.decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted: treat CD163 like CD45, levels by edge or gate. Superseded by R1: the registry was restarted from spleen measurements.

rows.topic: B cells are the immune checks' reference
rows.proposal: With P7's epithelial and stromal reference, CD45 read in 15-97 % of reference cells (scarce cells embedded among leukocytes, 43-288 left on HDL009/082/104), CD163 in 6-13 % on 3 sections and CD3e in isolated myeloid cells in 7-12 % on 4.
rows.source: level-selection trial on the 8 PC67 sections, 2026-11-01
rows.rationale: The pancreas reference (hormone cells) has no counterpart in spleen; B cells are abundant and mutually exclusive with T and myeloid cells.
rows.decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: "You need to be using CD20 as a ref or mutually exclusive marker for these." B cells (CD20, read at its own background peak until its level is chosen) are the immune checks' reference: CD3e, CD68 and CD163 at most CD45_AMONG_HORMONE_MAX on B cells isolated from T and myeloid leukocytes; CD45, which B cells carry, at least CD45_AMONG_CD3E_MIN among them. Superseded by R1: the registry was restarted from spleen measurements.

rows.topic: The spleen registry restarted from spleen measurements
rows.proposal: The first spleen registry was a copy of the pancreas CODEX registry (constants 'carried from codex-uniform-32__pancreas'); patched marker by marker, it kept failing on spleen.
rows.affects: every row and constant of phenocycler-pc67__spleen; positivity/lineage_levels.py
rows.source: level-selection trials on the 8 PC67 sections, 2026-11-01
rows.rationale: Parameters fitted on another tissue's images do not hold in lymphoid tissue.
rows.decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: "Looks like you are still using pancreas markers and methods on spleen which will not work"; "Stop trying to apply parameters used from a different dataset"; "Start the registry over"; "You have all the tools and information to handle these issues intelligently so do it." Rows from canonical marker biology (owner 10-28); levels from mutually exclusive spleen lineages (lineage_levels.py); constants measured on the 8 PC67 sections (SpleenFollicleCounterQP scripts/derive_spleen_typing_registry.py, build_spleen_typing_registry.py).
